programmes.t: Holmes 10th Anniversary Special: Behind The Overalls
programmes.d: Get a heartfelt look back at 10 years in the life of Canada's construction guru.
Mike Holmes' son, Michael Jr., needs help renovating his bungalow; Michael's modest ideas are turned upside down by Mike's ambitious plans to gut the bungalow and add a second story.
Tensions run high as Mike and Michael Jr. run into a revolving door of disagreements, including the second-floor layout, exterior brick choice and even the necessity of a dishwasher.

Mike and Michael Jr. take things to the next level as they decide to go into business together; they purchase an outdated, suburban property with an unusual layout, too many stairs, and open-concept headaches.

Mike and Michael figure out the open-concept dilemma at the Suburban House and turn their attention outside, where their plans for a spacious new deck come up short; they must quickly find a solution before the fast-approaching open house arrives.

Amanda and Shawn are best friends and work colleagues; they are looking to pool their money together to buy a vacation lakefront property that gives them each space of their own; first, they view a fully restored house that was built in the 1960s.
Newly engaged couple Michelle and Phil are looking for a lakefront home where they can entertain family and friends; Phil, a chef, is looking for a property with a great kitchen.

After retiring from technical jobs, Cathy and Mark are caretakers of Cathy's brother and are looking for a lakefront house that gives them room to focus on their art and a space for Cathy's brother to call his own.

Bruce and Darka have recently retired; they are also active scuba divers and want to find a lakefront property that will accommodate their passion for the sport, as well as entertaining friends and family.
Husband and wife Kelly and Michael are both professional bodybuilders who work together and train together.
A house begins flooding after two homes are built on either side.
